phrase.zh: 从一层开始，让形体逐渐出现。
phrase.en: A form appears one layer at a time.

visual.zh: 打印头和逐层升起的物体同框，强调制造过程由薄层累积成形。层纹是艺术描绘，并非可检测的成品缺陷。
visual.en: A printing head and a rising layered object share the frame, emphasizing accumulation into form. The lines are artistic, not inspected defects in a finished part.

background.zh: 增材制造根据数字设计逐层堆积材料来制作物体，常被称作 3D 打印。工艺可使用金属、塑料或陶瓷，但可用性和强度仍取决于材料、工艺控制与检验。
background.en: Additive manufacturing builds an object layer by layer from a digital design and is often called 3D printing. It can use metals, plastics or ceramics, while fitness and strength still depend on material, process control and inspection.
